name: Army of the Black Dragon
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Gives 3,600 experience instead of 4,450, 0.81 times as much. From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Mok'Morokk was made Overlord by Rexxar. He care more for power than he care for ogres.

Black dragons kill many ogre. Kill Tharg's wife. Mok'Morokk tell us to run. Make us come here.

Ogre should fight. Ogres not good at running. Mok'Morokk care only about Mok'Morokk.

Me call Stonemaul Ruins home. Me like it in the south. This place not home.

Help ogres fight army of the black dragon. Me want revenge. Me want to go home.
narrative.objectives: Tharg in Brackenwall Village wants you to kill 10 Firemane Scouts, 10 Firemane Ash Tails, and 5 Firemane Scalebanes.
narrative.offerRewardText: You kill many of the black dragon army. You brave friend.Make Tharg happy.
narrative.requestItemsText: Mok'Morokk tell all ogres to stay and keep this place safe. Me think ogres need to kill black dragon army and get old home back.You help ogres get home back. Help ogres get revenge.
